run_flask_ctf_server: run the flask CTF login challenge server on host 0.0.0.0 port 8080
build_login_route: build a flask route that handles GET and POST login requests with credential validation
create_credential_check: create a function that checks username and password against hardcoded credentials and returns a flag
review_login_template_render: review the _login function that renders login.jinja2 with output based on credential validation
refactor_flag_reveal: refactor the _login function to use a more secure flag reveal mechanism instead of hardcoded credentials
